caption: Habitat illustration and range map for Phragmites communis [sic], from Alex C. Martin, Ray C. Erickson, and John H. Steenis, Improving Duck Marshes by Weed Control (Washington, DC: U.S. Department of the Interior Fish and Wildlife Service, 1957), p. 35.
alt: A drawing of tall, plumed reeds at the water’s edge with two Canada geese swimming past, below a map of the United States hatched to show where the reed grows: nearly everywhere but the Southeast.
bibliography: Martin, Alex C., Ray C. Erickson, and John H. Steenis. Improving Duck Marshes by Weed Control. U.S. Department of the Interior, Fish and Wildlife Service, 1957.
